sloka: सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैर्नानापुष्पफलैर्वृताम् - यद्वा -सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः नाना पुष्प फलैः वृताम् ।सर्व काल मदैः च अपि द्विजैः समुपसेविताम् ॥३-५६-३३॥
transliteration: sarvakāmaphalairvṛkṣairnānāpuṣpaphalairvṛtām - yadvā -sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ nānā puṣpa phalaiḥ vṛtām ।sarva kāla madaiḥ ca api dvijaiḥ samupasevitām ॥3-56-33॥

translations.english: Thus instructed by Ravana, the demonesses took Sita into the Asoka grove, which was full of perenmal fruits and flowers of different kinds, where trees yielded fruits of all seasons and birds were always cheerful.
